allowed.reason: Moby Engine AuthZ-plugin bypass when a request body is oversized. This repository uses the Docker SDK as a client against a local daemon (internal/fleet/docker) and never serves the Engine API or loads AuthZ plugins, so the vulnerable server path is unreachable here; govulncheck only sees the client package's symbols.
allowed.revisit: Remove this entry as soon as github.com/docker/docker publishes a release containing the fix. The advisory lists no fixed version today, and v28.5.2 still scans as vulnerable.
